record.question: Answer any two of the following questions: (a) What are the circumstances under which lien of a post can be retained and what are the exceptions? (b) Under what circumstances are a period of an unauthorized absence shall be deemed to cause an interruption or break in the service of the employee? (c) Where a Government servant is formally appointed to hold full charge of the duties of a higher post in the same office as his own and in the same line of promotion, in addition to his ordinary duties, how is his pay to be regulated?
